episodes.name: Snow Gives Way
episodes.overviewEn: After being declared dead 15 years earlier, Danny Rand returns to New York. But his welcome is a far cry from what he'd hoped.

episodes.name: Shadow Hawk Takes Flight
episodes.overviewEn: Danny struggles with his new surroundings, Colleen dishes out a harsh lesson, and Joy sends an unconventional message.

episodes.name: Rolling Thunder Cannon Punch
episodes.overviewEn: Joy proves herself a shrewd businessperson, Danny recalls a painful memory, and Colleen puts her talents to good use.

episodes.name: Eight Diagram Dragon Palm
episodes.overviewEn: Danny makes a shocking discovery and a radical pricing proposal. Colleen's extracurricular activities goes viral, and Ward issues a stern warning.

episodes.name: Under Leaf Pluck Lotus
episodes.overviewEn: An insidious new drug hits New York. Danny recruits Colleen for the fight, and Claire discovers that credit cards can have many uses.

episodes.name: Immortal Emerges from Cave
episodes.overviewEn: Danny receives an invitation like no other. Colleen and Claire face a difficult choice. A worried Joy confronts her brother.

episodes.name: Felling Tree with Roots
episodes.overviewEn: Ward's loyalty is tested. Danny discovers a rogue division, and the mysterious Bakuto visits Colleen's dojo unannounced.

episodes.name: The Blessing of Many Fractures
episodes.overviewEn: Danny faces his fear, and Colleen meets her match. Joy makes a hasty decision while Ward struggles to accept his sister's admiration.

episodes.name: The Mistress of All Agonies
episodes.overviewEn: Madame Gao plays mind games. Ward's old habits catch up with him, and Danny discovers that he still has much to learn about being the Iron Fist.

episodes.name: Black Tiger Steals Heart
episodes.overviewEn: Exhausted from fighting, Danny tries to recharge with Bakuto's help. Meanwhile, Rand's management gets another shakeup.

episodes.name: Lead Horse Back to Stable
episodes.overviewEn: Claire uses her improvisational skills, and Colleen gets conflicting information. Danny yearns to be more than just a destroyer.

episodes.name: Bar the Big Boss
episodes.overviewEn: Ward receives an offer with strings attached. Davos advocates for an extreme solution, and a deadly duel gets personal.

episodes.name: Dragon Plays with Fire
episodes.overviewEn: In a desperate search to clear his name, Danny learns a terrible truth that places him on a new path.

episodes.name: The Fury of Iron Fist
episodes.overviewEn: While rival gangs battle for the soul of New York, Danny and Colleen cross paths with an old acquaintance. Joy embarks on a new adventure.

episodes.name: The City's Not for Burning
episodes.overviewEn: Danny and Colleen strive to broker a badly needed peace. Ward crashes his sister's auction, and Joy plays matchmaker -- with a twist.

episodes.name: This Deadly Secret...
episodes.overviewEn: In an effort to ease the tension between Ward and Joy, Danny and Colleen switch gears and host a dinner party. Mary delivers a warning.

episodes.name: Target: Iron Fist
episodes.overviewEn: Joy's interrogation of Mary takes a turn. Misty gives Danny an earful. Ward extends an olive branch. Davos makes a crucial discovery.

episodes.name: Heart of the Dragon
episodes.overviewEn: There's a new Iron Fist in town, and he's itching to make his presence felt. Meanwhile, Ward calls in a favor, and Joy considers her options.

episodes.name: The Dragon Dies at Dawn
episodes.overviewEn: Misty and Colleen's trip to the tattoo parlor turns painful -- but not for them. As Davos crosses names off his list, Mary makes Danny an offer.

episodes.name: Morning of the Mindstorm
episodes.overviewEn: As Danny steps up his training, Davos ramps up recruitment. Ward falls prey to old demons, and Misty butts heads with a captain.

episodes.name: Citadel on the Edge of Vengeance
episodes.overviewEn: Joy offers Davos tips on appealing to the masses, Danny begins to understand his limits, and Mary seeks the truth about her past.

episodes.name: War Without End
episodes.overviewEn: Facing a life-changing decision, Danny and Colleen debate their next move. Meanwhile, Davos's contempt for mercy grows stronger.

episodes.name: A Duel of Iron
episodes.overviewEn: In the season finale, Iron Fists collide as the fate of New York City hangs in the balance.
